packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Auto-merge devDependency minor bumps once CI passes

One Node major for CI, production and the types (#96): .nvmrc (the Node CI runs), the Dockerfile's node image (the Node production builds on) and @types/node move in one PR, so scripts/check-node-pins.sh stays green. config:recommended's group:nodeJs preset sets only a commit message topic, no group name, and does not match the npm package @types/node.
